mechanism_narrative: When monthly consumer demand proxies (HOUST) exceed 900, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days tend to be positive due to expectations of future economic expansion.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows where HOUST > 900, SPX 20d returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (> 0.25 percentage points in a single month) coincides with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as investors anticipate slower credit growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25% in a month
failure_condition: Over 60-day windows following such FEDFUNDS spikes, SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) above 6% for two consecutive months are associated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as profit expectations decline.
failure_condition: During qualifying UNRATE regimes, 20d forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 100 while CPIAUCSL is below 235 suggests resilient supply growth without inflationary pressure, predicting positive 5-day SPX returns.
regime_hint: robust supply growth with controlled inflation
failure_condition: Over 30 such (INDPRO > 100 & CPIAUCSL < 235) windows, 5d returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly retail employment (PAYEMS) surges by more than 10% from the prior month, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive, reflecting optimism about demand.
failure_condition: In 60-day windows after such PAYEMS jumps, returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the 3-month moving average of RSAFS indicate reduced investor demand for safe assets, which predicts negative S&P 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: 3-month moving average of RSAFS decreases for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: During such RSAFS declines, 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4% for a month, S&P 20-day forward returns tend to be positive as market anticipates economic expansion.
failure_condition: In qualifying UNRATE regimes, 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) suggests weakening manufacturing momentum, which is associated with negative S&P 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 10 such INDPRO declines, 60d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
